reasons.claim: Al-Sakuni relays with his unstated isnad from Amir al-Mu'minin, who gives the ruling and is the last link.
reasons.quote: وَ رَوَى اَلسَّكُونِيُّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ أَنَّ أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ

reasons.claim: Abu Ayyub and al-Ala' are co-transmitters at one level between Ibn Mahbub and Muhammad b. Muslim.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْخَزَّازِ وَ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ

reasons.claim: The Imam heard speaking is the last link.
reasons.quote: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ع يَقُولُ

reasons.claim: The chain is written after the story and names its own transmitters ending at the Imam; the persons in the story are not links.
reasons.quote: رَوَى ذَلِكَ مُوسَى بْنُ بَكْرٍ عَنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: A marked gap stands between al-Himyari and Ali b. Maymun, who narrates from the Imam.
reasons.quote: عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْحِمْيَرِيِّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ رَفَعَهُ إِلَى عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ الصَّائِغِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

reasons.claim: One chain of five links in text order, opened by «و أما حديث» which is not a name.
reasons.quote: وَ أَمَّا حَدِيثُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطٍ عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ

reasons.claim: Al-Nakha'i asks and the Imam he addresses answers, so the Imam is the last link.
Al-Sakuni with his unstated isnad; the Prophet ends the chain and is not a link.
reasons.quote: وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: Musa b. Bakr is in the genitive, joined to «عن عبد الكريم» under al-Bazanti's «عن», so al-Bazanti heads the second route too; the readers drop him from it.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ

reasons.claim: The closing remark contrasts Abd al-Karim's version with Musa's, both received by the same narrator.
reasons.quote: وَ زَادَ عَبْدُ اَلْكَرِيمِ فِي حَدِيثِهِ

levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن أبي نصر البزنطي
أحمد بن محمد بن أبي نصر البزنطي

notes: al-Bazanti narrates from both Abd al-Karim and Musa b. Bakr (genitive «موسى بن بكر» after «عن»)

reviews.uncertainty_note: The case ending makes Musa b. Bakr al-Bazanti's shaykh, but an unvowelled reading as a new subject is conceivable.

reasons.claim: Ali b. Ri'ab and Khattab are co-transmitters from Tirbal, giving two routes from Ibn Mahbub.
reasons.quote: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ وَ خَطَّابٍ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْهَمْدَانِيِّ عَنْ طِرْبَالٍ

reasons.claim: Abd al-Aziz tells of an encounter with al-Rida, who speaks inside it and is the last link (ruling 9).
reasons.quote: عَن أَخِيهِ عَبْد العَزِيز بْنِ مُسْلِم قالَ كُنَّا فِي أَيَّامِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسَى الرِّضَا
